title: AI Evidence and Confidence Structure v1
description: One entry per extracted field, not one score for the whole document. Each entry is stored as one row in the field_predictions table. Three values are kept apart: raw_value is the text exactly as the model read it, normalized_value is the cleaned value from the AI, and current_value is the value now in use after any human correction. A correction never changes raw_value, normalized_value, confidence or extraction_method. It sets current_value, corrected_by and corrected_at. Confidence is 0 to 1 here and in the database. The frontend shows it as 0 to 100.

field_key.description: Which field this evidence belongs to. Use the key from the Key column of the Field Dictionary v1. These are the same keys the frontend reads. A line item field uses the form lineItems[2].unitPrice.

field_label.description: The label shown to the reviewer, for example Total Payable Amount.

raw_value.description: The text exactly as the model read it, for example RM 4,500.00. Null for values that are worked out and not read from the page.

normalized_value.description: The cleaned value from the AI, for example 4500.00. The database stores it as text. The frontend calls it original.

current_value.description: The value now in use. Equal to normalized_value until a reviewer corrects the field. The frontend calls it value.

confidence.description: The model's confidence in this one field, from 0 to 1.

page_number.description: The page of the source document the value came from.

bounding_box.description: x, y, width, height on the page, when the extraction method can provide it. Leave it out when unavailable, do not send zeros.

extraction_method.description: PARSER is the deterministic spreadsheet path. MANUAL_CORRECTION is reserved and not used by the frontend today, because a correction keeps the original method.

model_name.description: For example qwen2-vl-7b, gemini-flash-lite or pandas-parser.

schema_version.description: Version of this evidence structure, so older records stay readable as the format changes.

corrected_by.description: The user who corrected the value, or null if it has not been corrected.
